Colourless or almost colourless crystals, or a colourless or almost colourless oily liquid. F.p. is not below 17°. Practically insoluble in water; miscible with alco- hol, with dichloromethane, and with fatty and essential oils. Store in well-filled airtight containers. Protect from light.
